newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers unchanged, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Offers unchanged, trade quiet.

text.p: Soybean basis offers were unchanged and trade was quiet Thursday because most end-users in the spot market have their needs covered, dealers said.
"It's quiet here and we're not seeing much interest," said an Illinois dealer. "The heat has probably taken a little demand but I think people will be back in next week."
The National Oilseed Processors Association will release its weekly crush on Friday at 0730 CDT, and trade sources expect the crush to range from 21.5 to 22.80 million bushels.
The figure is expected to fall below last's week's crush of 23.014 million because more plants are taking downtime, dealers said.
Additionally in Iowa, some crushing plants have been temporarily idled at the request of power companies because high temperatures have strained electric capacity, dealers said.
